name: api.last.app
description: The Last.app MCP gives AI agents secure, structured access to your restaurant data and operations — from sales, orders and products to customers, bookings and reporting.

_published_faq.name: How do I add api.last.app to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add api.last.app to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.last.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the api.last.app MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: api.last.app lists 16 MCP tools, including exportData, getBookingsRequirements, getCubeJSSchema, getIntegrations, getLocationDevices, getLocationPrinters, getLocationProducts, ingestSupplierDocument, listMyLocations, listMyOrganizations, listReservations, and queryCubeJS.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to api.last.app?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to api.last.app in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
api.last.app requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
api.last.app is developed by Last.app. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
